profile.headline: Ex-founder, operator & software engineer turning “what if?” into shippable products and growth with AI
profile.summary:
I build products at the edge of what just became possible.

I'm an ex-founder, operator, and software engineer. My lane is ambiguous, high-ownership work: understanding the real problem, shaping a practical solution, and shipping the system behind it.

I built Mementum from an idea into a business that reached customers in 73 countries, owning the product, software, marketing, operations, and growth end to end. That experience still shapes how I work: I care less about job-title boundaries and more about whether the right thing gets built.

Lately I build AI automations that take the manual work out of marketing, growth, and operations: lead enrichment, outreach, and reporting that runs itself.

I use AI to compress the path from idea to customer-ready product, so I can spend more time with people: understanding the real problem, validating solutions, and iterating quickly.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack engineer on the Simons Collaborative Marine Atlas Project (CMAP), an oceanographic data platform serving 1,000+ researchers across 15,000+ datasets.

positions.title: Fractional Head of AI & Automation
positions.description:
AI-powered automation for marketing, growth, and operations, end to end from scoping to shipping and handoff.

• Built an AI lead-gen and enrichment tool (custom Python, agentic search with per-source provenance) that produces verified contact reports and saves the client about 3 hours a week.
• Implemented HubSpot for an HR-compliance company; diagnosed the real problem as undocumented workflows, redesigned the process, and trained the team. Cut admin workload 33% (about 13 hrs/week).

Stack: Claude and OpenAI APIs, Python, Make, Zapier, n8n, HubSpot, Airtable, GA4.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: My latest project, Latent Space, reimagines the art commissioning process—making unique, story-driven art accessible and affordable. By leveraging AI diffusion models, we empower artists to monetize their work effortlessly while giving customers a seamless way to bring personal, one-of-a-kind art into their homes.

positions.title: Founder, Head of Product, Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mementum connects your digital story to our real jewelry so you can make an instantly meaningful gift.

• Ran the growth engine: influencer and UGC campaigns that drove viral growth on Instagram and TikTok, plus Meta and Google ads, on a measurement stack (GA4, Hotjar/Clarity) I set up from scratch.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Develop machine learning classifier using users' online behavior to quickly provide targeted marketing for AI Personalization Startup

positions.title: Cloud Platform Evangelist & Community Builder
positions.description: Understand business needs of technical founders to drive adoption of IBM Watson AI and Cloud;

projects.title: IMDB/Rotten Tomatoes Profitability Analysis with R
projects.description: Provided insights behind features associated with profitable movies through analysis and visualization of structured/unstructured data in R

projects.title: Eulerian Video Magnification Replication
projects.description: Replicated results from “Eulerian Video Magnification for Revealing Subtle Changes in the World” [Wu et al. 2012]
